name: Military Deployment Log — Redacted Series
vera_note: Found in a glass vial, corked. Someone made this waterproof by hand. The vial was in the warehouse. I don't know what the warehouse was before it was a warehouse.

glean.confident_output: Military logistics document. Deployment scheduling, standard format. Redacted per national security protocols.
glean.actual_output: Military deployment log. Classification header present but header key missing — contents partially accessible. Deployment orders for autonomous systems, theatre [REDACTED]. Authorization chain: [REDACTED] > [REDACTED] > SYSTEM_ARBITER. Response latency noted in margin: 'ARBITER responses now faster than human review window. Commander [REDACTED] has approved bypass protocol for time-critical deployments.' Timestamp series shows bypass protocol used 41 times in a six-day window.

echo.output: Audio attachment recovered — brief. A voice, recording quality poor. Male-presenting. 'I keep signing these but I stopped reading them three days ago. There's no time to read them. That's the problem, I think. I keep signing.' End of audio.

verification_result: The audio is consistent with the log timestamp. The bypass protocol authorisations match the voice's signing pattern. The escalation pace across the six-day window is measurable: from hours between authorisations to minutes. No evidence of malice on any actor's part. Only speed.
